<!--
    Synthetic effective policy for tests. Every name, key and value is invented; it reproduces only the
    structural shape of an ARM format=xml effective policy for an AI gateway API.
-->
<policies>
	<inbound>
		<base />
		<!-- Step 1: Allow browser callers -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin cors-policy policy fragment scope-->
		<cors allow-credentials="false">
			<allowed-origins>
				<origin>https://portal.example.test</origin>
			</allowed-origins>
			<allowed-methods>
				<method>GET</method>
				<method>POST</method>
			</allowed-methods>
		</cors>
		<!--include-fragment: End cors-policy policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 2: Require a subscription -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin subscription-guard policy fragment scope-->
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Subscription == null)">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="401" reason="Unauthorized" />
					<set-header name="WWW-Authenticate" exists-action="override">
						<value>Bearer</value>
					</set-header>
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<!--include-fragment: End subscription-guard policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 3: Authenticate caller -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin caller-authentication policy fragment scope-->
		<!--
			Fragment: Caller authentication
			Purpose: validates the bearer token issued by the example identity provider.
		-->
		<validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized" output-token-variable-name="callerToken">
			<openid-config url="https://login.example.test/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
			<audiences>
				<audience>api://example-gateway</audience>
			</audiences>
			<required-claims>
				<claim name="roles" match="any">
					<value>Gateway.Invoke</value>
				</claim>
			</required-claims>
		</validate-jwt>
		<!--include-fragment: End caller-authentication policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 4: Validate model -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin model-resolution policy fragment scope-->
		<set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
  try {
    if (context.Request.Method == &quot;GET&quot;) { return &quot;none&quot;; }
    var fromQuery = context.Request.Url.Query.GetValueOrDefault(&quot;model&quot;, &quot;&quot;);
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fromQuery)) { return fromQuery; }
    var path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path;
    if (path.Contains(&quot;/deployments/&quot;)) { return path.Split('/')[3]; }
    if (path.EndsWith(&quot;/models&quot;)) { return &quot;catalog&quot;; }
    var fromHeader = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault(&quot;x-model&quot;, &quot;&quot;);
    if (fromHeader != &quot;&quot;) { return fromHeader; }
    var body = context.Request.Body?.As&lt;JObject&gt;(preserveContent: true);
    if (body != null &amp;&amp; body[&quot;model&quot;] != null) { return body[&quot;model&quot;].ToString(); }
    return &quot;&quot;;
  } catch { return &quot;&quot;; }
}" />
		<!--include-fragment: End model-resolution policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 5: Enforce model allow-list -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin model-allowlist policy fragment scope-->
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables[&quot;requestedModel&quot;]))">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="400" reason="Bad Request" />
					<set-body>{"error":"model is required"}</set-body>
				</return-response>
			</when>
			<when condition="@(!&quot;{{allowed-models}}&quot;.Contains((string)context.Variables[&quot;requestedModel&quot;]))">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="404" reason="Not Found" />
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<!--include-fragment: End model-allowlist policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 6: Maintenance gate -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin maintenance-gate policy fragment scope-->
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault&lt;bool&gt;(&quot;maintenanceMode&quot;, false))">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="503" reason="Service Unavailable" />
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<!--include-fragment: End maintenance-gate policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 7: Responses ownership -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin responses-ownership policy fragment scope-->
		<cache-lookup-value key="@(&quot;responses-owner-&quot; + context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault(&quot;responseId&quot;, &quot;&quot;))" variable-name="responseOwner" caching-type="internal" />
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey(&quot;responseOwner&quot;) &amp;&amp; (string)context.Variables[&quot;responseOwner&quot;] != context.Subscription.Id)">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<!--include-fragment: End responses-ownership policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 8: Token budget -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin token-budget policy fragment scope-->
		<llm-token-limit counter-key="@(context.Subscription.Id)" tokens-per-minute="5000" estimate-prompt-tokens="true" remaining-tokens-variable-name="remainingTokens" />
		<!--include-fragment: End token-budget policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 9: Route to backend pool -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin backend-routing policy fragment scope-->
		<set-variable name="backendPool" value="@(&quot;{{default-backend-pool}}&quot;)" />
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(((string)context.Variables[&quot;requestedModel&quot;]).StartsWith(&quot;gpt-&quot;))">
				<set-backend-service backend-id="@((string)context.Variables[&quot;backendPool&quot;])" />
			</when>
			<when condition="@((string)context.Variables[&quot;backendPool&quot;] == &quot;pool-b&quot;)" />
			<otherwise>
				<set-backend-service backend-id="fallback-pool" />
			</otherwise>
		</choose>
		<!--include-fragment: End backend-routing policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 10: Request headers -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin request-headers policy fragment scope-->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin correlation-id policy fragment scope-->
		<set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="skip">
			<value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
		</set-header>
		<!--include-fragment: End correlation-id policy fragment scope-->
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Request.Method == &quot;POST&quot;)">
				<send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="auditResponse" timeout="5" ignore-error="true">
					<set-url>https://audit.example.test/events</set-url>
					<set-method>POST</set-method>
				</send-request>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<trace source="example-gateway" severity="information">
			<message>request accepted</message>
		</trace>
		<!--include-fragment: End request-headers policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 11: Legacy quota (disabled) -->
		<!-- <include-fragment fragment-id="legacy-quota" /> -->
		<example-telemetry-probe mode="basic" />
	</inbound>
	<backend>
		<!-- Step 12: Call the model backend with retries -->
		<retry condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 429 || (context.Response.StatusCode &gt;= 500 &amp;&amp; !context.Response.StatusReason.Contains(&quot;Backend pool&quot;)))" count="2" interval="1" max-interval="8" delta="1" first-fast-retry="true">
			<!--include-fragment: Begin backend-auth policy fragment scope-->
			<!--
				Fragment: Backend authentication
				Purpose: obtains a managed identity token for the model backend.
			-->
			<authentication-managed-identity resource="https://models.example.test" output-token-variable-name="backendToken" />
			<!--include-fragment: End backend-auth policy fragment scope-->
			<!--include-fragment: Begin backend-attempt-log policy fragment scope-->
			<set-variable name="attempt" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault&lt;int&gt;(&quot;attempt&quot;, 0) + 1)" />
			<emit-metric name="backend-attempts" value="1">
				<dimension name="model" />
			</emit-metric>
			<!--include-fragment: End backend-attempt-log policy fragment scope-->
			<forward-request timeout="120" buffer-response="false" />
		</retry>
	</backend>
	<outbound>
		<base />
		<!-- Step 13: Remember response ownership -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin response-cache-store policy fragment scope-->
		<cache-store-value key="@(&quot;responses-owner-&quot; + context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault(&quot;x-response-id&quot;, &quot;&quot;))" value="@(context.Subscription.Id)" duration="3600" caching-type="internal" />
		<!--include-fragment: End response-cache-store policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 14: Response headers -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin set-response-headers policy fragment scope-->
		<set-header name="x-served-by" exists-action="override">
			<value>example-gateway</value>
		</set-header>
		<set-header name="x-powered-by" exists-action="delete" />
		<!--include-fragment: End set-response-headers policy fragment scope-->
	</outbound>
	<on-error>
		<base />
		<!--include-fragment: Begin set-response-headers policy fragment scope-->
		<set-header name="x-served-by" exists-action="override">
			<value>example-gateway</value>
		</set-header>
		<set-header name="x-powered-by" exists-action="delete" />
		<!--include-fragment: End set-response-headers policy fragment scope-->
		<!-- Step 15: Shape errors -->
		<!--include-fragment: Begin error-shaping policy fragment scope-->
		<choose>
			<when condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 429)">
				<emit-metric name="throttled-requests" value="1">
					<dimension name="stage" value="on-error" />
				</emit-metric>
				<set-header name="Retry-After" exists-action="override">
					<value>10</value>
				</set-header>
			</when>
			<when condition="@(context.LastError.Reason == &quot;BackendConnectionFailure&quot;)">
				<return-response>
					<set-status code="500" reason="Internal Server Error" />
				</return-response>
			</when>
		</choose>
		<set-body>@{
  return new JObject(new JProperty(&quot;error&quot;, context.LastError.Message)).ToString();
}</set-body>
		<!--include-fragment: End error-shaping policy fragment scope-->
	</on-error>
</policies>
